bio: Podere 39 is the farm that supplies many of the products used in the restaurant. The menu features both land and sea offerings, including a must-try mozzarella in carrozza on basil cream and ricotta and parmesan gnudi, with norma-style tomato, eggplant powder, and salted ricotta. The setting is charming and atmospheric, with limited seating, so it's best to book in advance!...
